# Electric Furnace

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing) · [Recipes made here](#recipes-made-here)

<a href="Item-electric-furnace.md" title="Electric Furnace"><img src="icons/174.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Electric Furnace"></a>

Smelts and cooks the same recipes as the normal furnace using 200 W of electricity, with no item fuel.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Power demand | 200 W |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Craft at the Machinist’s Bench using one Furnace, one Machine Casing and four Copper Wire.

## Using it

Connect power on any face and open with right-click or Interact. Insert ingredients and collect output. Full power takes the same time as a normal furnace; shortages slow work. Pipes feed ingredients or extract products on any face. See the [Electric Furnace guide](Electric-Furnace.md) for setup.
